alerts.title: js-code-injection-eval
alerts.description: Code injection vulnerability detected. User-controlled input is passed to a code evaluation function, allowing arbitrary code execution. Avoid eval/exec with user input; use safe alternatives.

props.fix: Remove eval(), Function(), and setTimeout/setInterval with string arguments. Use JSON.parse() for data parsing. Use a sandboxed environment (vm2) if dynamic execution is needed.
props.vulnerabilityName: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

detailedReport.content:
## js-code-injection-eval

**Description:** Code injection vulnerability detected. User-controlled input is passed to a code evaluation function, allowing arbitrary code execution. Avoid eval/exec with user input; use safe alternatives.

**Location:** `workspace/app/routes/contributions.js` (line 32)

```
        const preTax = eval(req.body.preTax);
```

**Severity:** critical | **Confidence:** high

**What is CWE-94?** The product constructs all or part of a code segment using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify the syntax or behavior of the intended code segment.

**References:** [CWE-94](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/94.html) | [OWASP Top 10 A03:2021](https://owasp.org/Top10/A03/)

**Remediation:** Remove eval(), Function(), and setTimeout/setInterval with string arguments. Use JSON.parse() for data parsing. Use a sandboxed environment (vm2) if dynamic execution is needed.

alerts.title: js-template-injection
alerts.description: Template injection vulnerability detected. User-controlled data flows into template compilation/rendering. Use pre-compiled templates or sanitize input.

props.fix: Never pass user input to template compilation functions. Use pre-compiled templates with data binding. Enable strict mode in template engines.
props.vulnerabilityName: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine

detailedReport.content:
## js-template-injection

**Description:** Template injection vulnerability detected. User-controlled data flows into template compilation/rendering. Use pre-compiled templates or sanitize input.

**Location:** `workspace/app/routes/contributions.js` (line 32)

```
        const preTax = eval(req.body.preTax);
```

**Severity:** high | **Confidence:** high

**What is CWE-1336?** The product uses a template engine to insert or process externally-influenced input, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements or syntax that can be interpreted as template expressions or other code directives when processed by the engine.

**References:** [CWE-1336](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1336.html) | [OWASP Top 10 A03:2021](https://owasp.org/Top10/A03/)

**Remediation:** Never pass user input to template compilation functions. Use pre-compiled templates with data binding. Enable strict mode in template engines.
